name: Hinata Hideki
source:
Hinata is a bright, dependable boy who is the closest to Otonashi. He always tries to save his friends if he can and is a reliable force in the team. [spoiler]He and Yui constantly irritate one another on a daily basis, but deep down, he cares for Yui, as shown when he helps her pass on by telling her he would marry her.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angel_Beats!]Wikipedia[/url]]
